definition: Muscular dystrophy, limb-girdle, autosomal recessive 29 (LGMDR29; OMIM #620793) is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by biallelic variants in the SNUPN gene (encoding snurportin-1). The clinical spectrum spans from congenital or childhood-onset limb-girdle muscular dystrophy presenting with proximal weakness, restrictive respiratory impairment, and prominent joint contractures, to late- or adult-onset proximo-distal and axial weakness (resembling inclusion body myositis), as well as complex syndromic presentations featuring neurodevelopmental defects, cataracts, or spinocerebellar ataxia. Histopathology demonstrates dystrophic and myofibrillar-like changes including protein aggregates (e.g., myotilin deposits) and Z-disc disorganization, while muscle MRI typically shows predominant involvement of paravertebral, vasti, sartorius, and gracilis muscles.

source.title: SNUPN‐Related Muscular Dystrophy: Novel Phenotypic, Pathological and Functional Protein Insights
source.quote: SNUPN-related muscular dystrophy or LGMDR29 is a new entity that covers from a congenital or childhood onset pure muscular dystrophy to more complex phenotypes combining neurodevelopmental features, cataracts, or spinocerebellar ataxia.
